semantics.creation: Sample canonical HB when exact receipt bytes/object are created; stamp becomes part of receipt identity.
semantics.recording: Master Records independently samples canonical HB when first accepting the exact receipt; recording stamp is retained with custody and replayed unchanged on idempotent resubmission.
semantics.historical_receipts: Do not retrofit or fabricate HB stamps for receipts created before this contract.
semantics.authority: HB stamps are chronology/correlation evidence only and grant no admission, transition, execution, credential, routing, custody, publication, or governance authority.
